requested_operation: implement stable rule-specific SafeTensors validation diagnostics, configurable rank enforcement, and retry-safe borrowed-view ownership semantics

inputs.compiled_obligation_text: Validate metadata, dtype, shape, checked size arithmetic, offsets, complete coverage, limits, and borrowed-view ownership with stable diagnostic codes.
inputs.root_cause: The public validator collapsed all parser and resource-limit failures into SAFETENSORS_INVALID, did not enforce an explicit tensor-rank ceiling, and validation of a closed document raised an implementation ValueError. SafeTensorsDocument.close also cleared its mapped owner before owner.close succeeded, so an active borrowed view could turn a recoverable BufferError into a leaked mapping with no retry path.
inputs.affected_layer: SafeTensors reader validation, model ownership lifecycle, public validation reports, tests, and package documentation

defect_reproduction.environment: source-tree import from src/python/safetensors/src and src/python/core/src
observations: duplicate keys, malformed encoding, metadata types, dtypes, shapes, sizes, coverage, trailing data, header ceilings, and input limits all returned the same SAFETENSORS_INVALID code
a shape rank above ResourceLimits.max_nesting_depth was accepted
an active borrowed owner leaked BufferError instead of SafeTensorsError and was dropped before a close retry
validating a closed document raised ValueError from a released memoryview

implementation.reader_diagnostics: Every reader rejection point now attaches a stable SAFETENSORS_* rule code while preserving the existing exception type and message contract.
implementation.descriptor_classification: Shape, offset, checked-size overflow, sub-byte alignment, dtype, bounds, coverage, and trailing-data failures have distinct codes.
implementation.resource_limits: ResourceLimitError maps to SAFETENSORS_RESOURCE_LIMIT with the exact limit, actual value, and maximum retained in Diagnostic.details. Tensor rank uses max_nesting_depth.
implementation.model_validation: Closed documents return SAFETENSORS_DOCUMENT_CLOSED instead of touching a released memoryview; existing model diagnostics remain deterministic and exhaustive.
implementation.ownership_lifecycle: Document close marks payload access closed, retains a mapped owner when owner.close raises BufferError, reports SAFETENSORS_BORROWED_VIEW_ACTIVE, and permits a successful retry after exported regions are released.
implementation.compatibility: No public symbol was removed or renamed. SafeTensorsDocument.closed is an additive pre-1.0 property; existing exception messages and broad exception classes remain compatible.
implementation.tradeoff: ResourceLimits.max_nesting_depth is reused as the tensor-rank ceiling instead of adding a SafeTensors-only limits class. This preserves the common lifecycle signature and package boundary, but the generic field name is less explicit than max_tensor_rank.
